courses.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的水利與海岸設施；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring water and coastal works through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 河岸生態護岸
related.transfer: 可遷移「集合超越機率」與「預洩所需時間窗」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；河岸生態護岸的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Ensemble exceedance probability" and "Time window for prerelease" transfer, while hydraulic boundaries, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Bioengineered riverbank protection must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以集合預報、守恆與限制條件協調多水庫防洪；河岸生態護岸則以以水流荷載、活體建立與河岸監測共同設計護岸為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on coordinating reservoir flood operations using ensembles, conservation and constraints; Bioengineered riverbank protection centres on designing bank protection through hydraulic loads, plant establishment and monitoring, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「集合超越機率」與「河岸剪力的尺度」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到河岸生態護岸，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「纖維毯搭接與淨覆蓋」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Ensemble exceedance probability” and “Scales of bank shear”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Bioengineered riverbank protection, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Mat overlap and effective coverage", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Ensemble exceedance probability" and "Time window for prerelease" transfer, while hydraulic boundaries, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Riverbed grade-control structures must be respecified.

related.differenceEn: This course focuses on coordinating reservoir flood operations using ensembles, conservation and constraints; Riverbed grade-control structures centres on designing grade control through bed slope, energy dissipation and sediment continuity, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「集合超越機率」與「落差配置與縱坡」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到河床固床工設計，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「濾層粒徑的相容比較」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Ensemble exceedance probability” and “Drop spacing and longitudinal slope”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Riverbed grade-control structures, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Filter grading compatibility", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 洪水預報與水庫聯合操作
history.titleEn: Flood forecasting and coordinated reservoir operation
history.text: 俄羅斯河預報知情操作研究自二〇一四年起發展，公開案例包括門多西諾湖與索諾瑪湖。另一地區的美國氣象局中大西洋河川預報中心於二〇一七年底開始試行集合水文產品，不能把兩者寫成同一計畫。HEC 水庫網路手冊提供水庫、河段、節點與出口的概念分類。本課引用這些不同來源建立方法脈絡，並以原創集合與庫容數字檢查預報如何進入可追溯的操作比較。
history.textEn: Russian River forecast informed operations research has developed since 2014, with Lake Mendocino and Lake Sonoma as named cases. In another region, the Mid Atlantic River Forecast Center began experimental ensemble products in late 2017. These are distinct programmes. The HEC reservoir network manual distinguishes reservoirs, reaches, junctions and outlets. Together the references establish methodological context, while original ensemble and storage numbers demonstrate how forecasts enter traceable comparisons of operating alternatives.

history.titleEn: From engineering history to verifiable models

history.textEn: The course turns "Ensemble exceedance probability" through "Forecast improvement and independent validation" into 40 original analysis, testing and diagnosis tasks without copying source images, video transcripts, drawings or field procedures.
